polysolve.poly_solver module¶

polysolve.poly_solver.cubic(a, b, c, d)¶
polysolve.poly_solver.quadratic(a: float, b: float, c: float) → tuple[float, float]¶

Solves the roots of a quadratic equation.

Uses the quadratic formula. Result must be real.

a

\(x^2\) coefficient.

b

\(x\) coefficient.

c

Constant value.

Returns:

Positive and negative roots of quadratic.

Return type:

tuple[float, float]

Raises:

ValueError – Discriminant < 0 implying imaginary root.

Notes

Equation of the form:

\[ax^{2} + bx + c\]

Examples

>>> quadratic(1., 0., 0.)
(0.0, -0.0)
>>> quadratic(3., 0., -1.)
(0.5773502691896257, -0.5773502691896257)

See also

numpy.polyval

Evaluate polynomial at point.
